name: 𝐁𝐀𝐑𝐄 𝐁𝐎𝐍𝐄𝐒
source:
After the gruesome murder of his partner and almost becoming a victim himself, Detective Baron B Bones seeks revenge and is more determined than ever to find a serial killer that’s been terrorising Norema City.

ONE DECISION COULD CHANGE YOUR FATE!

Interrogate others, collect information, and find out who the killer is before they continue their murder spree or come back to finish the job!

[From [url=https://razzmatazz-art.itch.io/bare-bones]Itch.io[/url]]
